description: Update a User Group — rename it, change its handle, and/or add and remove members. Only the provided fields change. Returns the updated group.

group_id.description: ID of the User Group to update.

handle.description: New @-handle. Omit to keep the current handle.

members.description: Membership changes to apply (add and/or remove user ids).

add.description: User ids to add to the group.

rem.description: User ids to remove from the group.

name.description: New display name. Omit to keep the current name.

name: update_user_group
